notes.title: Yurif and GagaOOLala Launch Second Wave of Cross-Platform Collaboration!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41459652/40bf4a10451f58a45dad54d5f162b25c329b7008.png"]
Submit a Positive Review and Get a Free 7-Day VIP Pass to GagaOOLala
Yurif (Yuricat Games), a game development team dedicated to creating original yuri (girls’ love) titles, is launching the second phase of their collaboration with leading LGBTQ+ streaming platform GagaOOLala.
From July 21, 2025 at 00:00 to August 2, 2025 at 23:59 (GMT+8), players who play any game developed by Yurif / Yuricat, leave a positive review on Steam, and upload a screenshot of that review to the event page, will receive a 7-day VIP pass to GagaOOLala.
Quantities are limited and will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis.

🔗 Event Page:


https://yuricatgame.github.io/Redeem_VIP/



This campaign marks the second part of Yurif’s first-ever cross-platform collaboration with GagaOOLala. Unlike the first phase, which gave out free game keys, this phase focuses on rewarding community support by exchanging positive player engagement for streaming platform access. The goal is to bridge gaming and visual media, reaching more audiences who are interested in gender diversity and yuri culture.
[hr][/hr]🔹 Event Overview:
Duration: July 21 – August 2, 2025 (GMT+8)

How to Participate:
　1. Play any game developed by Yurif / Yuricat
　2. Leave a positive review on Steam and take a screenshot
　3. Upload the screenshot and complete the form on the event page
　　(After manual review, VIP codes will be sent via email within 3–5 days)
[hr][/hr]🔹 About Yurif / Yuricat Games
Yurif, officially incorporated as Yuricat Games in 2024, is known for crafting narrative-driven visual novels that explore romantic relationships between women. Released titles include Tied by Your Red and Evening Moon Flower, while upcoming projects such as Rafflesia Memorandum and Love Begins After Goodbye continue to expand their catalog of yuri storytelling.

The team is actively exploring multi-language releases, international collaborations, and original IP development. In addition to original titles, Yuricat is open to co-productions, licensing, and custom yuri game commissions. Those interested in telling heartfelt stories between women through interactive media are welcome to get in touch.
[hr][/hr]🔹 About GagaOOLala
GagaOOLala is Asia’s premier LGBTQ+ streaming platform, offering a wide range of BL, GL, and queer titles from around the globe. Their library includes popular Korean reality show His Man and GL hit Love My Scented Heroine, the award-winning Taiwanese series Fragrance of the First Flower (Seasons 1 & 2), and the beloved Thai GL film trilogy Yes or No. With over a hundred carefully curated lesbian films and series, GagaOOLala provides an all-in-one platform for queer women’s stories—no more searching across multiple apps.

notes.title: 【Update】Language Support Now Available for Tied by Your Red
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continued support and patience. Tied by Your Red now officially supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English. You can switch between these languages freely in the main menu for a more complete gameplay experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41459652/3cac375aaa19f6e3fecc7cfa50c2bdce98e545d2.jpg"]

About the Mac Version
At present, only the Windows version supports multilingual switching. Due to unresolved technical issues causing crashes in the Mac version after the update, it currently remains in its original Traditional Chinese version. We will release an update for Mac once the issues are resolved.

Upcoming Collaboration Event
We will soon announce details of a limited-time collaboration event with our partners—please stay tuned!

Thank you once again for your support and understanding. Enjoy the game!

Sincerely,
The Development Team
